entries.headline: Barack Obama launches podcast about books that "change the way we see the world"
entries.summary: Barack Obama is launching a podcast about books that have "profoundly shaped his worldview and our society." The podcast, called A Great Book with Barack Obama, will launch on Audible on September 24.
